shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && find app -type f | head -50 && echo "---" && cat app/**/*.tsx 2>/dev/null | head -60 && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts && echo "---TS---" && cat tsconfig.json
cd /workspace && cat app/lib/auth.ts && echo "---LAYOUT---" && cat app/layout.tsx && echo "---PAGE---" && cat app/page.tsx
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions && sed -n '/## Status codes/,/^## /p' loading.md | head -60

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference && grep -n "cacheComponents\|authInterrupts" 05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo "---EVAL DIR---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

(timeout 90 npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; echo "=== /admin ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/admin; echo "=== / ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/
grep -o 'Error 403\|Forbidden\|noindex\|Return home' /tmp/admin.html | sort -u; echo "=== robots meta ==="; grep -o '<meta name="robots"[^>]*>' /tmp/admin.html
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; cat .gitignore; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short
rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
